info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Fooddelivery Deliveries Ratings-v1-spec
info.description: The Delivery Ratings Retrieval API enables stakeholders to access and evaluate the ratings associated with food delivery services. This endpoint provides a comprehensive overview of user sentiments regarding deliveries, which can be instrumental for restaurants, delivery services, and market analysts. By leveraging this information, businesses can enhance service quality, address customer concerns, and make informed operational decisions. Typical consumers of this API include food delivery platforms and data analysts seeking insights into customer satisfaction.

get.summary: Retrieve the rating for a delivery.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the rating information for a specific delivery. You can use this endpoint to evaluate the quality of service based on customer feedback.
